scope: Infinite-y shallow sinusoidal relief between two homogeneous dielectric half-spaces. TE/TM matching at the actual interface with both reflected/transmitted propagating and evanescent orders. Not a solution of the 2D AG; Rayleigh expansion validity is not assumed for general surfaces.
boundary_conditions: TE: continuous E_y and (d_z-h_prime*d_x)E_y. TM: continuous H_y and epsilon^-1*(d_z-h_prime*d_x)H_y. Identical normal-length factors cancel.
flux: TE order flux ratio k_z_out/k_in * |t_m|^2; TM multiply by epsilon_in/epsilon_out. Haze denominator includes every transmitted propagating order. Unpolarized result sums TE/TM transmitted powers for equal incident powers.
validation: Flat Fresnel controls T=.96 and R=.04, order cutoff 8/16/32/48, 4x/6x boundary oversampling; residual on offset independent double-density points; energy balance and 32->48 haze convergence.

execution_context.device: CPU; no new native GPU solves
